findings.detail: The extracted holdings rows have blank issuer_name even though the source schedule company column contains Sun Acquirer Corp. for the matching common stock positions.

rationale: C201 flags missing issuer_name. The bundle's extracted holdings sample shows blank issuer_name for Sun Acquirer Corp. common stock rows with cost/fair value 615/892 and 43/62, while the raw source table 50 rows 21 and 22 explicitly list Sun Acquirer Corp. in the company/issuer column for those same common stock positions. The source therefore proves a real extraction gap, not a false alarm. No aggregate anchor was needed.
